title: James J. Hamula
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Germany Munich Mission, 1977-79
Bachelor's and Masters degrees in Political Science/Philosophy from BYU, Juris Doctorate from BYU
Married Joyce Anderson, Mesa Arizona Temple 1984. Parents of six children
Attorney and shareholder in an Arizona law firm
Bishop, Stake President, Area Seventy in the North America Southwest Area
President of the Washington D.C. South Mission, 1994-97
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
